description: GPU utilization and vLLM engine metrics. GPU node filters apply only to GPU panels; namespace/gateway/model/role/pod filters apply to engine panels. Role comes from Kubernetes pod labels. Gateway/client latency is on MIF — AIGateway.

targets.expr: avg(gpu_gfx_activity{hostname=~"$amd_nodes"} or DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname=~"$nvidia_nodes"})
sum by(gpu_id) (gpu_gfx_activity{hostname="$amd_nodes"})
sum by(gpu_id) (gpu_gfx_activity{hostname="$amd_nodes"})
sum by(gpu_id) (gpu_used_vram{hostname="$amd_nodes"}) / (sum by(gpu_id) (gpu_total_vram{hostname="$amd_nodes"}))
gpu_junction_temperature{hostname="$amd_nodes"}
sum by(gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname="$nvidia_nodes"})
DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname="$nvidia_nodes"}
DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{Hostname="$nvidia_nodes"}
